issue.title: The `badge` function should be more flexible

summary.text: The verifier reproduced the issue and found inputs that break the fixed `clldutils.badge.badge`: labels or messages containing dashes (e.g. label='a-b', message='1-2', or message='X-X' with an empty label) are inserted unescaped, producing ambiguous shields.io URLs such as 'https://img.shields.io/badge/a-b-1-2-green.svg'.
